test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.**

The lecturer said to the class, “You should start preparing for the examination.”

options.text: The lecturer advised the class you have to start preparing for your examination.
The lecturer advises the class to start preparing for the examination.
The lecturer advised the class to start preparing for the examination.
The lecturer had advised the class to started preparing for the examination.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The lecturer advised the class to start preparing for the examination.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and we need to convert it to indirect speech.
 
• When we change an direct speech into indirect speech, we must follow these rules:
 
• The given sentence is also an imperative sentence.
 
 
• The sense of command, order, advise, request and suggest is implied in the reported clause of the sentence. We have to change the reporting verb in accordance with the mood of the sentence. 
 
• In the imperative sentence the reporting verb ‘said’, ‘said to’, ‘told’ changes to advised, command, requested, ordered, etc. depending on the mood of the sentence. 
 
• Imperative sentence changes to statement form [direct to indirect speech]
 
• The modal '**should**' in the indirect speech is **omitted **because we use '**to**' in forming the direct speech part.
 
• We use 'to' to connect the two clauses in the indirect speech part. when advising something to someone.
 
 
 
• Example - *Mother said to me, “Think before you act.” (Direct)*

* Mother advised me to think before I act. (Indirect) *

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Indirect speech: *The lecturer advised the class to start preparing for the examination.*
